A. History and Development of the Company
We were founded in November 2014, as Nextev Inc., which was changed to our current name NIO Inc. in July 2017. Significant milestones in our development since 2025 include the following:
●
In January 2025, we completed the repurchase right offer relating to the 2027 Notes. US$378.3 million in aggregate principal amount of the 2027 Notes were validly surrendered and not withdrawn prior to the expiration of the repurchase right offer. Following settlement of the repurchase, US$213,000 aggregate principal amount of the 2027 Notes remained outstanding and continue to be subject to the existing terms of the indenture and the 2027 Notes.
●
In April 2025, we completed HK$4,030.13 million offering relating to 136,800,000 Class A ordinary shares, to non-U.S. persons in offshore transactions in reliance on Regulation S under the Securities Act.
●
In April 2025, we officially launched and started deliveries of firefly, our small smart high-end electric car.
●
In July 2025, our smart large-space flagship SUV, the ONVO L90, was officially launched, with user deliveries starting shortly after.
●
In August, 2025, our flagship premium SUV, the NIO All-New ES8, was officially unveiled and made available for pre-orders, and user deliveries commenced in late September.
●
In September, 2025, we completed a US$1.16 billion registered offering relating to a total of 209,090,918 Class A ordinary shares, including those in the form of ADSs.
●
In February 2026, NIO Inc. and GeniTech Co., Ltd., or Shenji, a subsidiary of ours, entered into definitive agreements with certain investors in China, or the Shenji Investors, pursuant to which the Shenji Investors will invest an aggregate of RMB2.257 billion in cash to subscribe for Shenji’s newly issued shares. Upon completion of the investment transaction, a subsidiary of NIO will continue to hold a controlling equity interest of 62.7% in Shenji and NIO will continue to consolidate its financial results. The Shenji Investors will collectively hold 27.3% of Shenji’s equity interest. Certain entities holding shares to administer Shenji’s share incentive plan will collectively hold the remaining 10.0% of Shenji’s equity interest.
●
In April 2026, our flagship executive SUV, the NIO ES9 was officially unveiled.

B. Business Overview
Our Chinese name, Weilai ( 蔚来 ), means Blue Sky Coming.
We are a pioneer and a leading company in the global smart electric vehicle market. We aspire to shape a sustainable and brighter future with the mission of “Blue Sky Coming”. We envision ourself as a user enterprise where innovative technology meets experience excellence. We design, develop, manufacture and sell smart electric vehicles, driving innovations in next-generation core technologies. We distinguish ourself through continuous technological breakthroughs and innovations, exceptional products and services, and a community for shared growth.
Our Key Technological Breakthroughs and Innovations
Since our inception, we have remained committed to innovation and dedicated to investing in research and development of core technologies for smart electric vehicles. Our technological breakthroughs and innovations differentiate us from our peers, creating better user experiences and enhancing user confidence in us. Underpinned by the adoption of AI, we have established full-stack capabilities in 12 areas of smart EV technologies including assisted and intelligent driving, digital technologies, battery swapping, electric powertrain and battery, vehicle engineering and design capabilities, and others. Our capabilities have enabled us greater flexibility to continually improve our current products and launch new products. By integrating these industry-leading technologies, all of our vehicles are designed to provide our users with a relaxing, interactive, intelligent, and immersive experience.
We have strategically established our research and development offices across different countries and regions that we believe give us access to the best talent. Our global research and development center for production models is located in Shanghai. Our advanced vehicle manufacturing center is located in Anhui. Our global research and development center for software is located in Beijing. Our global research and development center for autonomous driving is located in San Jose. Our global design center is located in Munich. Our global research and development center for advanced engineering is located in Oxford.
Assisted and Intelligent Driving
We believe that assisted and intelligent driving is the core of smart electric vehicles. Since inception, we have prioritized this area through sustained long-term investment. We are one of the first companies in China to offer enhanced ADAS capabilities and we have been dedicated to developing our proprietary full-stack assisted and intelligent driving capabilities spanning technical architecture, hardware deployment, algorithms, and training data closed-loop systems.
At the data level, NIO’s proprietary collective intelligence framework enables a full functional data closed loop on the vehicle side. Combined with generative simulation and closed-loop simulation technologies, this framework support the continuous generation of diverse and complex data coverage for model training, contributing to the improvements in model and system iteration efficiency.

On the model and algorithm front, we continue to advance technological innovation. At NIO IN 2024, we unveiled the auto industry’s first world model — NIO WorldModel (NWM), a multivariable autoregressive generative model capable of processing multi-source information, performing comprehensive multimodal understanding, and generating diversified execution outputs. With long-horizon temporal modeling capabilities, NWM is designed to better handle complex real-world driving scenarios. We also introduced NADArch2.0, an end-to-end architecture for our assisted and intelligent driving powered by NWM, aimed at providing a safer and more seamless driving experience for users. In 2025, we further upgraded NWM, by introducing full closed-loop reinforcement learning into assisted and intelligent driving and expanded the application of the foundation model across all intelligent driving functional modules at the architectural level. Since late January 2026, the latest iteration of NWM has been fully rolled out to applicable vehicles, which further improved system capabilities and driving experience.
In terms of training compute, supported by extensive data, continuous model iteration, and enhanced improvements in closed-loop reinforcement learning efficiency, combined with our highly optimized utilization of computing resources, our model performance and real-world application outcomes remain competitive within the industry. To support long-term development, we plan to scale up our training compute capacity to meeting the evolving requirements of the NWM architecture.
In the intelligent driving chipset domain, our in-house developed automotive-grade intelligent driving chip, NX9031, has been deployed in certain NIO brand models starting from 2025. We have established full-stack in-house development, mass production and deployment capabilities for intelligent driving chips. Going forward, we plan to continue iterating our chip products and gradually expand deployment across brands and models.
From an AI infrastructure engineering perspective, we have developed and deployed assisted and intelligent driving systems across three generations of chipsets. In 2025, we achieved scaled delivery of intelligent driving functions across NIO and ONVO platforms based on different chipsets and hardware configurations, demonstrating strong multi-platform parallel development and efficient mass-production capabilities.
